mappings.product_miss: The shared public product covered work, unemployment and sickness broadly but had no focused source-grounded route for the authority boundary between an ordinary jobseeker, an Arbetsförmedlingen programme participant and a part-time jobseeker who also has employment.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Use the existing shell and person surface with focus=unemployed_sick. Ask programme status first because it can change the first-day recipient; fail closed when programme status is uncertain; keep mixed employment separate; never turn reporting guidance into an eligibility decision.
mappings.truth_guardrail: Försäkringskassan and Arbetsförmedlingen current primary pages carry the truth. Sickness reporting is not proof of sickness-benefit eligibility and registration at Arbetsförmedlingen is not proof of programme participation.
mappings.privacy_guardrail: Only coarse route state stays in the client session. Do not place diagnosis, medical certificate content, SGI, salary, employer, identity or the person's situation text in URL or structured feedback.
